menus.name: Découverte menu
menus.note: Dinner, Monday to Saturday. Inspirational wine pairing HK$1,388, Experience mixed pairing HK$1,088, Balade non-alcoholic pairing HK$588; blue lobster course HK$488 extra

menus.name: Savoir-Faire executive lunch
menus.note: Lunch, Monday to Saturday, with a choice at most courses; extra courses and supplements available. Wine pairing HK$488 or HK$688, mixed HK$388 or HK$588, non-alcoholic HK$288 or HK$488

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or by phone, WhatsApp (+852 9099 9609) or email (reservations@cristalroombyasp.com). A prepayment is taken when booking.
cancellation: Prepayments are non-refundable. A booking can be passed to someone else, and if it has to be moved for unforeseen reasons the restaurant offers a credit for a future visit. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
groups: A private dining room can be booked through SevenRooms.
dressCode: Formal or smart casual. No sportswear, shorts, tank tops, sandals or flip-flops.
children: Children aged 10 and over are welcome, under the same dress code.
duration: About two and a half hours at lunch and three hours at dinner.
byob: Corkage is HK$800 a 750ml bottle of wine and HK$1,600 a magnum or bottle of spirits, plus 10% service. Outside cakes are not allowed.
